en.about_bio: I help engineering teams build immutable, automated, and economically sound cloud platforms. With over a decade of hands-on experience with enterprise teams across financial services, automotive, and technology in EMEA, LATAM, and North America, I translate complex cloud challenges into scalable business capabilities.
en.about_service1_desc: Designing scalable Internal Developer Platforms (IDP) that reduce cognitive load and accelerate deployment cycles.
en.about_service2_desc: Automating entire environments with Terraform and GitOps. Stop manual toil and ensure consistent, reproducible infrastructure.
en.about_service3_desc: FinOps-driven analysis to identify waste, rightsize resources, and implement guardrails, typically saving 30-50% on bills.
en.about_cta_text: From infrastructure roadmaps to cost governance — turn your cloud environment into a competitive advantage.

pt.about_bio: Ajudo equipes de engenharia a construir plataformas cloud imutáveis, automatizadas e economicamente sólidas. pt.about_service1_desc: Projeto de Internal Developer Platforms (IDP) escaláveis que reduzem a carga cognitiva e aceleram os ciclos de deploy.
pt.about_service2_desc: Automação de ambientes completos com Terraform e GitOps. Elimine o trabalho manual e garanta infraestrutura consistente e reproduzível.
pt.about_service3_desc: Análise orientada a FinOps para identificar desperdícios, redimensionar recursos e implementar guardrails, tipicamente economizando 30-50% na fatura.
pt.about_cta_heading: Precisa de um parceiro cloud sênior?
pt.about_cta_text: De roadmaps de infraestrutura à governança de custos — transforme seu ambiente cloud em uma vantagem competitiva.
